rules: Licence manifest of the CSCA overview photos (src/content/csca/photos, bundled by static import so they are served from /_next/static/media). Real campus photos only, Pexels only; no logos, signage, CSC or CSCA marks, no images from csca.cn or agencies; no caption presents a university as a partner (Pexels License: no implied endorsement). Files re-encoded on 2026-10-17 from the unchanged originals: WebP q72 method 6 and JPEG q:v 6 (720 px fallback), Lanczos, metadata stripped. Originals and the selection log stay outside Git in output/student-app-v2/csca-overview/photos of the canonical checkout.
